verdict.rationale: Meltano is a data pipeline platform with a hosted option, so publishing a machine-readable API spec is a fair axis for it. The evidence documents only a CLI, and probes of common OpenAPI/Swagger paths on the docs site all returned 404. Nothing shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
